newsitem.title: CANADA: Vermilion Resources finalizes asset buy.
newsitem.headline: Vermilion Resources finalizes asset buy.

text.p: Vermilion Resources Ltd said on Friday that it had completed negotiations on all issues related to its recent acquisition of oil and gas assets.
The assets currently produce 4,300 net barrels of light oil per day and include more than 25 million barrels of proven and probable oil reserves, it said in a statement.
Vermilion gave no details about the vendor of the assets or their location.

With the acquisition, Vermilion's production will increase to 6,500 barrels of oil equivalent per day, 32.5 million barrels of proven and probable oil equivalent reserves and more than C$30 million of annualized cash flow, the company said.
